title: Fair Treatment of Seafarers - candidate-reported correction and scope pass
rationale: A candidate reported that the QB1_A Q25 answer on Fair Treatment of Seafarers omitted the Casualty Investigation Code and asserted two instruments that do not exist. The reported card was rebuilt and the scope pass that followed found the same fact wrong in one further card, an unrelated MLC citation defect, and teaser drift on two free sample pages. The edits are correct and were verified against primary sources before this record was written; what was missing was an authorisation record the historical batch guards could recognise. This manifest is that record. It rebaselines nothing: every batch keeps its own pins, and delegation is granted only for the six card anchors named below.
content_index_effect: meoclass1/qb_content_index.json and its governed twin were regenerated by the correction. Canonical total is unchanged at 721 - this event edits cards, it creates and deletes none.
note: CORR-FT-06 is classified SCOPE_PASS_CORRECTION, not a fair-treatment correction. It is declared here because this event edited that card; the classification keeps the record honest about what was one fix and what merely shared a commit.

artefacts.rationale: Free sample cited MEPC.338(76) as the CII calculation and rating guidelines. G1 is MEPC.336(76), G4 is MEPC.339(76). The gated copy was already correct.

artefacts.rationale: Same defect; additionally records that MEPC.337(76) is G2 (reference lines) and MEPC.338(76) is G3 (reduction factors) so neither is quoted for calculation or rating.
artefacts.guarded_by: no release guard pins this file

cards.rationale: The card the candidate reported. Casualty Investigation Code (MSC.255(84)) was absent entirely; MLC 'Regulation 5.2.7 / Standard A5.2.7' and 'LEG 110 / LEG 111 VDR outputs' were fabricated. A.987(24) remains recommendatory; the mandatory seafarer-protection requirements come from Code Part II Ch 12 via SOLAS XI-1/6, with Part III Ch 24 recommended practice. Detained-seafarer instrument is LEG.7(112), 28 March 2025.
Related-link labels on the neighbouring card pointed at the pre-correction framing of Q25. Changed only because Q25 changed.
Page dependency-graph card names the instruments Q25 rests on; restated to match the corrected instrument chain.
The free-sample copy of the same dependency-graph card. Mirrored byte-for-byte with the gated copy, before and after.

Same fact wrong in a second card: the Casualty Investigation Code does not 'incorporate' the fair-treatment Guidelines, it cites them and carries its own Part II Ch 12 protections. Also removed an unverifiable medical-fitness/fatigue interrogation claim and re-attributed consular access to VCCR Art. 36 and MLC Guideline B4.4.6(2).

INDEPENDENT of the fair-treatment fact. Found by the MLC-citation sweep that the primary correction triggered: MLC Regulation 2.7 is Manning Levels, not Recreational Facilities; corrected to Reg. 3.1. Declared here because this correction event edited it, not because it shares the primary card's subject.
